correctness.rationale: The rank-one no-jump generator splits into the cyclic H-subspace generated by the trap and a dark invariant complement; all bright eigenvalues have negative real parts. The capture projector formula is then a sum over distinct H-eigenvalues with positive weights. Rational affine independence of the prime-cycle cosine eigenvalues and disjoint cyclotomic fields exclude nontrivial collisions except unordered (k,l) swaps for equal prime and equal couplings. Fourier cosine sums evaluate to f_p and the diagonal kernel B_p, yielding the site classes and both ranks. Positive κ cancels from eventual capture; p=q=5 and trap/axes/diagonals satisfy boundary formulas.
